chunks: Or do they have the unknown, so they write it down?

key_terms.الْغَيْبُ: The unseen or hidden knowledge, specifically that of God

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Or do they have the unseen?'
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question challenges the polytheists' claim of possessing exclusive knowledge of the unseen (al-Ghaib), which they used to validate their idols or prophecies. It underscores the principle that true knowledge of the unseen belongs solely to Allah, refuting the notion that humans can independently record or dictate divine will. This verse serves as a foundational argument against human arrogance in claiming divine attributes.
